clips.title: The story
paras: "James Hyal" is an Alliance quest concerning a human settler who sailed to Kalimdor with Lady Jaina Proudmoore's expedition. After setting out to open an inn on the frontier, his family in the Eastern Kingdoms lost touch with him and seeks news of his fate through Theramore's administrative records.

During the Third War, countless souls left their ancestral homes in the Eastern Kingdoms to follow Lady Jaina Proudmoore across the Great Sea. Among them was James Hyal, remembered fondly by his kin as a gifted cook. After the fighting subsided and Theramore Isle was founded, James chose to carve out a living on the rugged continent of Kalimdor by opening an inn of his own to serve travellers and fellow settlers.

Back in the Eastern Kingdoms, James's brother has grown concerned after receiving no recent correspondence from across the sea. Hoping that James is merely consumed by the demands of managing a bustling roadside taproom, he asks passing travellers to track him down. The first step in finding him lies in Theramore, where Clerk Lendry oversees local records and keeps track of expedition members who have ventured out into the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. Damn fine cook he was.
I haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in Theramore could probably point you to him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: James Hyal, James Hyal... Why does that name sound so familiar?
Of course! The Shady Rest Inn incident. If you have any information about what happened there, I would urge you to speak with Captain Vimes about it. He's handling the investigation.
